Sub:- Inter — State Allocation under Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana- Remunerative Approaches for Agriculture and Allied sector Rejuvenation (RKVY-RAFTAAR) for the year 2021-22 - regarding.

I am directed 10 convey approval 08 the Competent Authority for: State/UniOn Territories (UTs) wise allocation of funds (Central Share) for Normal RKVY-RAFTAAR under General, Special Component Plan for Scheduled (5088) and Tribal Sub Plan (TASP) for 2021-22 as per 076 Statement annexed. '

Like last year, funds under RKVY — RAFTAAR during 2021-22 have. been provided separately for NER' States and other States with a further trifurcation among General, SCSP and TSP components. The allocation under Normal RKVY — RAFTAAR (General Component) has been calculated as per the criteria envisaged in Appendix B of RKVY — RAFAAR: Guidelines. The funds earmarked under SCSP and TSP components have been allocated 10 States on the basis 08 SC/ST in the respective States. For. UTs, funds have been allocated on the basis of their utilization during previous 76೩/5, :

Accordingly, the inter-state allocation (Central Share) of Normal RKVY — RAFTAAR under General, SCSP and TSP components have been approved by the Competent Authority as per column — 3 , 4 and 5 of the Statement annexed. Funds will be released to the States under these 3 components of different budget heads separately for which 5608810 Utilization Certificate will be required to be submitted by the States to this Departments.

It is reiterated that the changed funding pattern of RKVY — RAFTAAR from 100:00 to 60:40 between Centre and State (90:10 for the North Eastern and Himalayan State) since 2015- 16 shall also: be applicable for the financial year 2021-22, States need to contribute States share ೩೦೦೦161131: However, for UTs the grant is 100% under RKVY —RAFTAAR.
